full_judgment: 4. On 7-4-2019, the defendant nos. 1-4 entered appearance and filed an application under Order VII, rule 11 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure stating that the plaint is liable to be rejected as the same is barred by law. The plaintiff filed a written objection against the said application stating that the application is not maintainable as the defendants did not file written statement. Subsequently, on 20-5-2019 the defendant No. 1-4 filed written statement denying the material allegations so made in the plaint and stated that the suit is not maintainable in its present form, the suit is barred by limitation and section 42 of the Specific Relief Act.
